items.en_title: Igaratinga (MG) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 27 #04
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Igaratinga (MG) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 20; proposals close Nov 27, 08:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
